methods.name: Odd-N BRC admissible multiplier scan / strong square-gap cascade
capabilities: safe deletion of all m congruent 2 mod 4 for odd-N difference-of-squares search
exact m->m+2 retained-root/remainder transport with at most three BRC basin corrections
zero-false-negative two-table squarehood prefilter using moduli 20160 and 46189
experimental static multiplier ranking from admissible nontrivial divisor-ratio count
methods.core_law: For odd N, m==2 mod 4 cannot satisfy x^2-y^2=mN. The admissible monotone path therefore has 75 states through m<=100. One-step transitions reuse t0.brc_multiplier_transition; two-step skips use a dyadic sqrt((m+2)/m) predictor and at most three odd-width corrections. A square gap must pass both mod-20160 and mod-46189 tables, whose uniform joint pass fraction is 108/46189.
methods.hard_boundary: Parity pruning, quadratic-residue filtering, Lawrence/Lehman/Hart multiplier-Fermat search, and rational factor-ratio selection are classical prior art. The nu(m)^4/m priority is experimental only and is not a theorem, default proof path, RSA shortcut, or asymptotic improvement. Finite timings and finite hit-rate samples do not imply factorization complexity progress. The BRC-specific proved addition is retained-state m->m+2 transport and its composition with the existing multiplier transition tool.
